issues.title: Add health endpoint
issues.bodyText: The container needs a liveness probe. Add GET /healthz returning 200 with no body, and wire it into the Compose stack so a failing start is visible without reading logs.

issues.title: Flaky test in adapters package
issues.bodyText: adapters/github flakes about one run in twenty on CI. Suspect the fake server's port being reused before the previous test released it.

pullRequests.title: Wire up refresh lease
pullRequests.bodyText: Takes the lease before the first fetcher runs and releases it in a deferred call, so a crashed run does not hold it for the whole TTL.

pullRequests.title: Add Plausible adapter skeleton
pullRequests.bodyText: Draft while the migration is still being written. Do not merge before 0002 lands.
